about: Elizabeth C. Pritzker is a top-rated attorney helping clients with Antitrust Litigation. She also assists with General Litigation and Class Action / Mass Torts: Plaintiff issues.
She works in Emeryville, California serving the surrounding community.
Elizabeth Pritzker attended University of San Francisco School of Law and graduated in 1989.
She was selected to Super Lawyers for 2011 - 2026.
